title: fix(app-shell): a full-page record form opened by direct URL returns inside the app after save or cancel
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu76CdcjMmgYPLs3UuMF1RMq)_

## 维护者速读
- 改了什么:整页记录表单(新建 / 编辑)保存或取消后，只有当本控制台会话里确有上一页时才"后退"，否则进入记录详情(编辑)或对象列表(新建)。
- 为什么改：从粘贴链接、新标签页或深链打开表单时，原来按浏览器标签页的历史长度判断，会退出应用跳到控制台首页，保存提示也随旧页面一起丢失。
- 风险与回滚：只改 `RecordFormPage` 的返回判定一处；应用内进入的行为不变。回滚即还原该文件一个提交。
- 先看:`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordFormPage.tsx` 的 `goBack`(`hasInAppHistory`),然后看新测试 `RecordFormPage.directUrlReturn-27454.test.tsx`。
- 两分钟验证：在新标签页直接打开 `/_console/apps/com.example.showcase/showcase_task/new`,填写并点 Create,应看到 `Task "TITLE" created` 提示并停留在任务列表(应用内)。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

Fixes #27454
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## What changes
- `RecordFormPage`'s `goBack` decided "came from inside the app" from `window.history.length > 1`. That counts the tab's entries from before the console document loaded, so a form opened by pasted URL, new tab or deep link went Back out of the app, and the save toast fired just before the document unloaded.
- It now reads react-router's own location key: the entry the router started on is keyed `'default'`, every entry it navigated to gets a generated key. Back only when the key is not `'default'`; otherwise the existing parent route (record detail in edit mode, object list in create mode) with `replace`. This is the same rule `FormPage`'s cancel already uses in the console, and the same route in-app entry takes when nothing is behind it, not a second fallback.
- Save and cancel share `goBack`, so both follow the rule; edit mode (`/record/ID/edit`) is covered by the same change.

## Tests
New `RecordFormPage.directUrlReturn-27454.test.tsx`, with `window.history.length` stubbed to 3 on every cell:
- edit, direct URL: save toasts `Task "Quarterly review" updated` and lands on the record detail;
- create, direct URL: save toasts `Task "Quarterly review" created` and lands on the object list;
- edit, direct URL: cancel lands on the record detail, no toast;
- edit and create, in-app entry (an earlier router entry): save and cancel go back to that page.

Ablation (one-shot, through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, restored to the HEAD blob): putting the `window.history.length > 1` test back turns the three direct-URL cells red and leaves the two in-app cells green, as predicted.

## Acceptance notes
- `ui/packages/layout/src/PageHeader.tsx` (its back button) uses the same `window.history.length > 1` pattern. That is the back-button control, a different bug class from the after-save route; left unchanged here.
